correctness.rationale: The published sink retraction identifies the space with the subcomplex \(K_m\) of \(C_m\times C_m\) containing every product cell except \(e_i\times e_i\). Replacing each missing square interior by a smaller invariant disk produces a genus-one surface with \(m\) boundary components that strongly deformation retracts to \(K_m\), hence a wedge of \(m+1\) circles. The coordinate swap has cellular traces \((m,0,0)\), so Lefschetz gives first-homology trace \(1-m\) and eigendimensions \((1,m)\). The standalone verifier reconstructs the complete chain complex for cycle lengths from \(3\) through \(12\), checks \(\partial^2=0\), achieves the theoretical maximum ranks modulo \(2,3,5,7\), and reproduces all character formulas. The finite checks are explicitly not used as the all-parameter proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Chettih--Lütgehetmann give general generators and a sink model, while Ramos gives general cellular/asphericity results and exact tree homology. These results do not determine a free fundamental group, exact wedge rank, or the \(S_2\)-character for non-tree all-vertex cycles. The punctured-torus deformation supplies the missing implication.

originality.rationale: The final claim was compared at statement and implication level against the two foundational sink-configuration papers, targeted web searches, the published-finding index under multiple aliases, and the existing prior ledger. Chettih--Lütgehetmann provide the deformation model and only a one-sink circle base case; Ramos provides the all-vertices model, Euler characteristic, asphericity and tree formulas, but explicitly separates the difficult general-graph case and does not identify the all-vertices cycle two-particle homotopy type or label-swap character. No checked source states a stronger theorem that yields the complete claim without the new punctured-torus identification and equivariant trace calculation.
residual_risks: An uncatalogued note, thesis calculation, or non-indexed exercise could contain the same special case; targeted searches did not reveal one.
The representation statement depends on using the natural coordinate-permutation action and the coordinate-symmetric deformation model; the proof states this normalization explicitly.

value.rationale: All-vertices sink configuration spaces are a standard object in the literature, cycles are the canonical first non-tree family, and two particles are the minimal setting with a nontrivial label action. The result converts the general discrete model into a closed all-parameter homotopy type and an exact \(S_2\)-module, giving a compact benchmark for non-tree sink configurations and for representation-theoretic calculations. The family is structural rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
